text: {"assertions":["A data loss bug in mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt was fixed on 2026-05-11 affecting the mobile sync side.","The data loss bug only occurred for records with non-ASCII names.","The root cause was floating point rounding in the money path.","The bug was reproduced by force stopping the app with unsynced edits, causing a local row to be missing after the next launch.","The fix moved arithmetic operations to integer minor units, submitted in PR #6291 on branch fix/data-loss-1.","The backlog was cleared 74 minutes after the deploy.","This data loss fix addressed the same area of mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt as earlier data loss work, allowing context to carry over."]}
